title: COCOLOFA: A Dataset of News Comments with Common Logical Fallacies Written by LLM-Assisted Crowds
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection and classification of logical fallacies in text. While the news topics used to generate the dataset include 'Religious Conflict' and 'Human Rights', the core benchmark evaluates logical and rhetorical structures rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics themselves.
